text: DSH Dify Marketplace 是面向 Web 客户端的 DSH 插件，在设置页面提供 Dify 插件市场。用户可以搜索和浏览插件、分类、合集与详情，查看版本和凭据字段，并通过本机 Dify plugin daemon 安装、卸载插件。安装后，支持的 Dify 工具、数据源、触发器、模型及扩展会映射为 DSH 工具、模型调用或 HTTP 路由，并可在设置中管理凭据。适合希望从 DSH 内发现并接入 Dify 插件的用户；需要访问 Dify Marketplace，安装功能还需要配置 daemon。

Browse Dify plugins, bundles and collections from DSH web Settings. Inspect details, then install or uninstall through a local Dify plugin daemon. Supported plugins register as DSH tools or model and HTTP integrations. Requires Marketplace access and a configured daemon for installs.

插件市场浏览：在 DSH 设置中按关键词和分类搜索 Dify 插件或 bundles，并查看精选合集、插件详情、版本和凭据字段。
安装 Dify 插件：从插件详情启动安装并显示任务进度；服务端通过 Marketplace 下载 .difypkg，再交给 plugin daemon 安装并注册为 Cordis 子插件。
接入已安装工具：符合支持类别的 Dify 工具会注册为 DSH 模型可调用工具，调用时由 daemon 执行并返回结果。
插件凭据管理：详情页呈现凭据字段，保存前由 daemon 校验；通过后凭据存入 Host 本地 vault 并重新挂载插件。

dsh-dify-marketplace README · dsh-dify-marketplace：A DeepSeek Harness plugin that embeds a Dify Marketplace micro-frontend in Settings, talks to the public `marketplace.dify.ai` HTTP APIs, installs `.difypkg` packages through the official [dify-plugin-daemon](https://github.com/langgenius/dify-plugin-daemon), and mounts each installed Dify plugin as a Cordis child fiber.

This is not an official Dify or DeepSeek product.

dsh-dify-marketplace README · Compatibility：| Surface | Pin |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `dsh-v0.1.0-rc.7` (`99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca`) |
| Package name | `dsh-dify-marketplace` (not `@deepseek-ai`) |
| Delivery track | Host + Web UI |

No `dsh` CLI was installed on the machine that bootstrapped this repository. Develop against the Harness tag above.

dsh-dify-marketplace README · What this plugin does：- Browse and search Dify Marketplace plugins (All / Models / Tools / Data Sources / Agent Strategies / Triggers / Extensions / Bundles).
- Show collections, tags, and plugin detail including credential schemas.
- Download `.difypkg` via the marketplace download-url redirect and install through the daemon.
- Register Dify tools on `ctx.tools` under `dify__<org>__<plugin>__<tool>` after a successful install.
- Store credentials on the Host. The browser never holds secrets.

dsh-dify-marketplace README · Install (after a release commit exists)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh --profile web
```

From a public commit:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-dify-marketplace#<40-character-commit>
```

Disable: remove the bundle row from the profile or uninstall the package with `dsh plugin`. Uninstall of an individual Dify plugin is a product flow inside Settings, not `dsh plugin remove`.

dsh-dify-marketplace README · Configure：Host config (Cordis row):

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `marketplaceBaseUrl` | Defaults to `https://marketplace.dify.ai` |
| `daemonBaseUrl` | Attach to a running daemon instead of supervising Compose |
| `daemonServerKey` | Daemon `SERVER_KEY` |
| `daemonTenantId` | Tenant path segment (`/plugin/:tenant_id/...`) |

Secrets live under `$DSH_HOME/storages/dify-marketplace/` (`installed.json` and `credentials/`).

dsh-dify-marketplace README · Verify：```sh
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm test:e2e
```

`pnpm test:e2e` is the live marketplace information-architecture journey. The Settings journey needs a running web profile: `DSH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port> pnpm test:e2e:dsh`. Daemon install tests need Compose: `pnpm daemon:up && pnpm test:integration`.
